# JetBrains Mono (console font)

- Source: https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono, release tag `v2.304`, commit `cd5227bd1f61dff3bbd6c814ceaf7ffd95e947d9`
- File: `JetBrainsMonoNL-Regular.ttf` (the no-ligatures build), taken unchanged from the release zip `JetBrainsMono-2.304.zip`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL.txt` (bundling and redistribution allowed; the font is not sold on its own)
- Use: the debug console's monospace UI font (src/engine/console/font_atlas.h); copied next to the exe as `fonts/JetBrainsMonoNL-Regular.ttf`.
